name: HeaderMinersBox
description: Two-row miner-count cell for the dashboard's header strip. Top row carries the app-side `online / error / offline` breakdown; the bottom row pairs the `online / total` ratio with the pool-side equiva…
descriptionFull: Two-row miner-count cell for the dashboard's header strip. Top row carries the app-side `online / error / offline` breakdown; the bottom row pairs the `online / total` ratio with the pool-side equivalent. Numbers fall back to `—` when undefined, and the pool counts are dropped entirely when the site has no pool (see `showPool`)

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown next to the "Miners" label. Caller-provided so the package stays icon-agnostic

props.name: total
props.description: Total miners across the site (denominator of the `158 / 2,188` ratio)

props.name: error
props.description: Miners flagged in warning (the small amber count)

props.name: appTotal
props.description: Optional app-side meta line — total miners reporting to the app

props.name: poolTotal
props.description: Optional pool-side meta — total miners as reported by upstream pools

props.name: showPool
props.description: Whether to render the pool counts on the second row. Defaults to `true` only when one of `poolTotal` / `poolOnline` / `…
props.descriptionFull: Whether to render the pool counts on the second row. Defaults to `true` only when one of `poolTotal` / `poolOnline` / `poolMismatch` is passed, so a site with no upstream pool shows no empty `Pool (—) — —`. Pass it explicitly to hold the counts' space while they load, or to drop them despite having a pool. The row's `online / total` ratio is app-side and always rendered
